name: SK_ID_PREV
details: ID of previous credit in Home credit related to loan in our sample. (One loan in our sample can have 0,1,2 or more previous loans in Home Credit) [Metadata note: hashed.]

name: SK_ID_CURR
details: ID of loan in our sample [Metadata note: hashed.]

name: NUM_INSTALMENT_VERSION
details: Version of installment calendar (0 is for credit card) of previous credit. Change of installment version from month to month signifies that some parameter of payment calendar has changed

name: NUM_INSTALMENT_NUMBER
details: On which installment we observe payment

name: DAYS_INSTALMENT
details: When the installment of previous credit was supposed to be paid (relative to application date of current loan) [Metadata note: time only relative to the application.]

name: DAYS_ENTRY_PAYMENT
details: When was the installments of previous credit paid actually (relative to application date of current loan) [Metadata note: time only relative to the application.]

name: AMT_INSTALMENT
details: What was the prescribed installment amount of previous credit on this installment

name: AMT_PAYMENT
details: What the client actually paid on previous credit on this installment
